title: A reply Claude Code writes for an API error is not marked as an error
foundBy: session agent, while adding the synthetic field for TRC-015
details:
Claude Code writes a `<synthetic>` assistant record for some replies it makes without the model, including an API error, which also carries `isApiErrorMessage`. The adapter now marks these `synthetic`, but not as errors. This is the Claude Code counterpart of the codex failure R67 fixed, and a turn that died on the provider still reads as a reply.

A session whose first assistant record is synthetic also sets `meta.model` to `<synthetic>`, since the model is taken from the first one.

No captured corpus holds an API-error reply, so a fixture or unit test has to be built for it.
